# finepro-tools

Current compact context for coding assistants.

Product:

- Internal manufacturing-operations mobile app.
- Dashboard launches checklists, CNC/dimension, foundry, molds, repair machines, devices/gauges, factory map, coating warehouse, dewax, gas, insulation wrapping, pallets, tools, and bonus modules.
- Root tabs are dashboard and settings. Old batches/devices/alerts tab documentation is obsolete.

Stack:

- Expo SDK 55; React Native 0.83.10; React 19.2; TypeScript 5.9 strict.
- Expo Router typed/protected routes.
- react-native-unistyles 3, TanStack React Query 5, Zustand 5.
- Axios with main and module-specific clients.
- react-i18next locales: en, vi, zh-CN, zh-TW.
- MMKV 4, React Hook Form, zod/v4.
- Vision Camera, NFC, BLE, Expo Updates.
- Jest 29, ESLint 9, Prettier 3; Yarn 1 only.

Key locations:

- app/: routes and layouts.
- src/features/: domain modules.
- src/common/components/index.ts: public shared UI.
- src/providers/: auth/query/alert/sheet/camera/NFC/drawer/update providers.
- src/services/api/: typed Axios clients and helpers.
- src/config/env.ts: environment mapping.
- src/theme/: tokens, metrics, Unistyles.
- src/utils/app-version.ts: app/runtime/OTA version constants.

Rules:

- Read AGENTS.md first; inspect nearby feature code.
- Preserve unrelated changes; never edit .env.
- Use shared components and Unistyles tokens; no hardcoded colors.
- Translate visible strings in all four locale files.
- React Query for remote state; Zustand selectors for shared client state; useAuthStore for auth.
- Match the feature's existing Axios client and specify response generics.
- No any, suppression directives, or --no-verify.
- Run relevant tests and yarn validate before handoff.
- Commit/push/OTA/APK/deploy only when explicitly requested.

The current source has no Supabase integration.
